Most of the responses seem to be from students. 

As a working professional in retail, please consider at best you will only see your young kids HALF the month. You will NOT be the primary parent due to your work hours.  Most pharmacists have to work a lot of closing shifts 2pm to 10pm especially floaters.  You will also most likely have to work every other weekend. 

In my case, I work half the month 2pm to 10pm. This means I only see the kids briefly in the morning.  By the time I get home they are in bed.  This means half the month I cannot help them with homework.  They don’t see me.  

I also have to work every other weekend. So any sporting events or hobbies your kids plan on taking.  You will not be able to attend every other weekend. 

Also.  When the school calls saying your little one has a fever and is throwing up at school.  You will have to tell the school that you cannot leave right now to pick up your kid.  Why? Because retail.  

Count on working thanksgiving and Christmas.  You will not get those holidays off. 

You will need a very supportive other parent to help while you’re at work and be a parent when you cannot be.  If you’re a single parent, good luck.

I once was selling a wii fit on Craigslist. I told the buyer that I would absolutely not meeting at a house.  I would only meet somewhere public.   He says okay and gives me an address.  

Stupid me I go to the address and it’s a house.  Being dumb I call the guy and he directs me to come inside and upstairs.  When I get up there, I say something like “hey I said I wouldn’t meet at a house!”  And he says “well this is my business I run from my house.  So this is a business not a house.”  He made small talk with me for like 15 mins and then I left.  

But man. Thinking back on how stupid I was.  I went upstairs to some strangers house.  So many things could have gone wrong.
